runs.text: Read the year you were born and show how old you will turn in 2030. The program shows only the number.

hints.text: Fill in the card: what goes in, what comes out and what sum would you do by hand with 2015?
You need a box for the year, and to read it. Look at the greeting in
After reading, a single subtraction is enough.

runs.text: Also read the current year and show how many years are left until 2030. (With 2026: 4 are left.)
Hidden cases: being born in 2030 gives 0, and distant years check that no fixed number was used. Frequent mistake: subtracting the other way round and getting negatives.
